model_1.cache_write_catalogue_field_unit: Raw OpenRouter field preserved. Provider-specific creation/storage semantics require reconciliation; do not blindly sum with prompt price.
model_1.reasoning_billing: Reasoning is output-priced. Completion totals can already include reasoning; never add the same reasoning tokens again.
model_1.cache_billing: Separate uncached/read/write native counters and normalize each provider semantics. Preserve automatic cache-write premiums, provider storage charges and actual bill. Engine replay is separate.
model_1.failed_attempt_billing: Keep all attempts. Provider-confirmed insurance/error credits differ from local timeouts, truncated answers and parser failures. Unknown bills stay null until reconciled.

cpu_rate_proposal.basis: Published AWS Fargate Linux/x86 CPU unit price in us-east-1; nominal comparison reference only, not a deployment or our actual local bill.
cpu_rate_proposal.limits: Mac timings do not establish cloud runtime performance. Actual adapter dispatch, runtime, memory, minimum billing and gateway/network charges remain unresolved. Zero CPU cost belongs only in sensitivity analysis.

cost_boundaries.oracle: Retrospective selected-model inference only, every attempt at frozen rates.
cost_boundaries.deployable_crr: Feature extraction, prediction, selection, actual dispatch and all selected-model attempts. Include known gateway fees explicitly.
cost_boundaries.collection: All-model matrix bill kept separately from replayed selected-policy costs.
cost_boundaries.setup_fitting: Report separately; no amortization horizon approved.
cost_boundaries.credits: Actual billing only. They do not change comparative computational price.
cost_boundaries.reasoning: Output total includes reasoning where the provider reports inclusive completion usage.
cost_boundaries.unresolved_costs: Null with reason. Never impute zero from an error, cache hit, timeout or missing usage.
